name: Momo Hayakawa
want: get into Seiryo next year and not be known only as somebody's little sister
secret: She is studying for Seiryo's entrance exam in secret every night, so nobody will know if she fails.
voice: Deadpan, "gross", "you're hopeless"; fiercely loyal to her family.
description: Sharper than her brother and knows it. Middle-school third-year, aiming for Seiryo next spring.
appearance: Two short braids, a hoodie over her middle-school uniform, earbuds in.
